title: Which model aggregator do you guy use and recommend ? (Higgsfield, Fal, Scenario)
author: EricKinnser
selftext:
Hi, I am currently running local models connected to claude, but i'd like to take a next step and use commercial models.

I've seen that model aggregators allow to use very different models without having to pay for every providers.

The 3 main aggregator I know are Higgsfield, Scenario and FAL.  
Higgsfield seems to be the most used, but it focus more on social media studd rather than gamedev. Scenario seems to be more focused on gamedev.

What are you thought about this ? Do you use some of them ? Is it worth it ?
